original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).

actual_scope: Exact P112 two-total correction at source-union sizes 44..47: joint deletion-loss upper bound, rank-two cancellation obstruction and charged COPY lower bound.
scope_change_reason: The user assigned structural decoder research with OS seed 49. Three candidate mechanisms were considered: higher-dimensional label tables, high-rank matched masked supports, and the two-total source-support boundary. The latter is an explicitly open interface after PR1787/PR1827; it changes the number of decoder totals and source supports rather than searching the closed eight-term family. This is a scoped algebraic side result, not the catalogue card’s 5% physically priced construction.
bottleneck_link: A cheaper complex COPY decoder could reduce the binding supplier cost. The favorable screen grants all helper, access, frame, restoration, hosting and precision work zero extra cost; a no-saving lower bound on the remaining COPY bill rules out this bounded support mechanism even under that relaxation.
stop_rule: Stop after a complete support/kernel argument through source union 47, an exact two-column obstruction or counterexample, positive all-pairs identity fixtures, negative controls and package verification. No search at source union >=48, arbitrary larger label tables or full supplier implementation. Final 15 of 60 minutes reserved for verification and handoff.
evidence: RESULT.json: exhaustive finite kernel/support premises through 47; geometric maximum five at each size 44..47; 56 nonzero rational cancellation minors exclude realization by two correction columns, giving retained-loss upper bound four and full-rank on-column COPY floor 66. Exact overlapping rank-two fixture costs 75 and attains retained loss four; rank-three relaxation costs 81 and attains five. Neither is a supplier gain.
